admission_gates.rule: evaluate VALIDATION only; TEST stays unconsumed and unauthorized
identifiable VALIDATION decisions >= 200 and distinct hands >= 100
every answered decision carries pooling.level and pooling.source_key == requested_key
support.source_key == requested_key for every answered decision
EXACT_EMPIRICAL_STRONG is emitted only at L0_EXACT_KEY

calibration_and_admission.outcome_rule: ADMIT_CANDIDATE only when every frozen gate passes; otherwise RETAIN_ACTIVE_REFERENCE
calibration_and_admission.unresolved_nodes_do_not_fail_the_run: a node that stays EXACT_UNRESOLVED is reported as such; it is neither an admission nor a defect, and it never blocks the outcome decision

evaluation.outcome_rule: ADMIT_CANDIDATE only when every frozen gate passes; otherwise RETAIN_ACTIVE_REFERENCE
evaluation.universe: non-Hero public preflop decisions of the #319/#321 focus families where the candidate and every comparator both answer the same exact requested key
evaluation.unresolved_policy: fails-closed decisions are reported and excluded from the paired predictive gates; they never score as correct by defaulting to FOLD

checks.detail: AST scan: the generator uses none of the forbidden holdout loader symbols, imports no validation/holdout module and declares no hand-history archive, decision JSONL or fixture snapshot path
AST scan: the generator uses none of the forbidden holdout loader symbols, imports no validation/holdout module and declares no hand-history archive, decision JSONL or fixture snapshot path

checks.excluded_from_scan: protocol artifacts (schema/kind mentions protocol, or a *protocol* filename) and every result that does not reference the hierarchical candidate — including the #352 exact-price comparator, which consumed VALIDATION under its own frozen protocol

checks.detail: the generator parses no hand-history archive and no decision JSONL; it consumes content-addressed evidence artifacts only. The build ran with a filesystem tripwire: any open under the certified dataset tree or of an archive/decision file aborts the build.

predecessor_validation_reads.note: recorded as evidence, not repaired: the #352 split consumption belongs to the exact-price candidate, so it neither violates nor satisfies this candidate order guard

authorized_when: the frozen VALIDATION evaluation returns outcome=ADMIT_CANDIDATE
every frozen gate passes with the threshold values pinned in this protocol
the VALIDATION result is content-addressed (schema poker-hierarchical-validation-result/v1, embedded protocol_byte_sha256) and pinned in a new explicit #367 protocol revision
issue367_rule.consequence_when_forbidden: no #367 real ISO EV run, no exact-support grid extension and no provider wiring may consume this candidate; #367 keeps its current admitted model
forbidden_while: the outcome is RETAIN_ACTIVE_REFERENCE or the candidate stays UNRESOLVED
no ADMIT_CANDIDATE VALIDATION result exists for this candidate
the candidate SHA differs from the pinned canonical payload digest
a #367 run would change TEST consumption, Model B, Hero EV or the active Model A pointer
issue367_rule.question: is a #367 consumption of the hierarchical candidate authorized or forbidden?

metrics.mandatory_reporting: a pooled estimate is never scored without its pooling level; calibration must not be reported on pooled support as if it were exact support
metrics.pairing_rule: a paired delta is computed only on decisions both models answer at the same requested key

primary.definition: mean over scored decisions of -ln p_hat(observed_action | requested_key)
primary.name: multiclass_log_loss

secondary.definition: expected calibration error, 10 equal-count bins per action class
secondary.name: ece

secondary.definition: share of in-scope decisions answered with a non-UNRESOLVED reason code
secondary.name: coverage

secondary.definition: share of in-scope decisions that stay UNRESOLVED and emit no action
secondary.name: abstain_rate

secondary.definition: mean effective sample size of answered decisions
secondary.name: mean_effective_sample_size

not_an_admission: this protocol admits nothing by itself: it fixes the rules, the thresholds and the comparators before the VALIDATION holdout is opened

order_guard.detection: declared result locations first, then a content scan of analysis/**/*.json for result-shaped payloads that declare a VALIDATION read and reference the candidate
order_guard.evaluation_side_rule: the evaluation command must call assert_protocol_frozen_before_validation() before it opens a single VALIDATION hand
order_guard.excluded_from_scan: protocol artifacts (schema/kind mentions protocol, or a *protocol* filename) and every result that does not reference the hierarchical candidate — including the #352 exact-price comparator, which consumed VALIDATION under its own frozen protocol
order_guard.rule: the freeze fails closed when a VALIDATION result that references the hierarchical candidate already exists

output_schema.evidence_digest_rule: result.evidence_sha256 = canonical sha256 (sorted keys, compact separators) of the result payload without its own evidence_sha256 field

pooling_limits.discipline: an estimate reported above L0_EXACT_KEY is labelled EXACT_HIERARCHICAL_ESTIMATE, is never counted as exact support, and never satisfies an exact-support gate
forbidden: raising the 20/20 support thresholds after reading VALIDATION
pooling_limits.statement: a key A may never be declared supported by observations of a different key B; support counts are exact and pooling only feeds the prior

base_prior.rationale: weak uniform prior so sparse cells stay wide instead of collapsing to zero

constraints: a parent never adds support observations to the requested key
no cross-level smoothing of the support counts themselves
priors_and_shrinkage.exact_weight: w_exact = n0 / (n0 + kappa0), non-decreasing in n0

protocol_byte_sha256_location: the protocol digest cannot live inside the protocol payload; it is recorded in FROZEN_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL.sha256 and validation_protocol/ARTIFACTS.json and re-verified by the evaluation-side order guard

publication.downstream: only an ADMIT_CANDIDATE outcome may be consumed downstream; a rejected candidate leaves the active Model A v5 pointer unchanged

seeds.purpose: the frozen estimator is a closed-form Dirichlet shrinkage; the recorded seed only pins observation ordering and tie-breaking, no sampling is performed

thresholds.coverage_is_not_an_admission_gate: a lower coverage than the active reference never counts as an admission and never justifies lowering a frozen support threshold; fail-closed abstention is correctness
thresholds.exact_claim_requires: L0_EXACT_KEY meeting both the 20-observation and 20-distinct-hands thresholds
